content.question: What does the self-attention mechanism allow the Transformer to do?
options: Let each word attend to all other words in the sequence, with learned weights based on relevance, capturing long- and short-term dependencies.
Let each word attend only to the immediately preceding word.
Process one time step at a time while keeping hidden memory.
Compress the whole sequence into a single vector before reading it.
content.answer: Let each word attend to all other words in the sequence, with learned weights based on relevance, capturing long- and short-term dependencies.
